title: GEMglMultTransposeMatrixd
description: multiply the current matrix with the specified row-major ordered matrix

messages.description: list of 16 values, the matrix in row-major order

body: [GEMglMultTransposeMatrixd] calls glMultTransposeMatrixd() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glMultTransposeMatrix in the OpenGL reference.
